description: Subtle NW–SE oriented low-relief trench (~3–4 m wide, ~50 m long) visible in filtered hillshade; co-located with a linear NIR-bright band indicating moisture retention or anthropogenic dark earth.

Right-angled pair of lineations (~20 m on each leg) in the SE quadrant, visible as convex ridges in curvature maps and as NIR-bright/visible-dark vegetation stress, suggestive of embankment corners or raised-field parcels.
